Title: Select robust indicators based on missingness

Compute missingness per indicator and keep indicators with missing_rate <= 0.30.

  - missing_rate must match the fraction of missing values in outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv.

import pandas as pd

# Load the input data
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
output_missingness_report_path = 'outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv'
output_selected_matrix_path = 'outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv'

# Read the input CSV
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Calculate missingness for each indicator column
indicator_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]
missing_data = df[indicator_columns].isna()

missing_counts = missing_data.sum()
total_entries = missing_data.shape[0]
missing_rates = missing_counts / total_entries

# Determine which indicators to keep based on missing rate
kept_indicators = missing_rates[missing_rates <= 0.30].index.tolist()

# Prepare the missingness report
missingness_report = pd.DataFrame({
    'indicator': indicator_columns,
    'missing_count': missing_counts,
    'missing_rate': missing_rates,
    'kept': missing_rates <= 0.30
}).sort_values(by='indicator')

# Save the missingness report
missingness_report.to_csv(output_missingness_report_path, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONNUMERIC)

# Filter the original dataframe to keep only the selected indicators
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]

# Save the selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv(output_selected_matrix_path, index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_NONNUMERIC)
</solution_file>
